description: This PHP class file belongs to the OpenCart e-commerce platform and provides data operations for the 'Information' entity within the catalog module. It includes methods to create, read, update, and delete information entries, along with handling associated descriptions, SEO URLs, layouts, and store associations.

classes.name: Information
classes.description: Represents the data access layer for managing Information entries within the catalog module of OpenCart.

methods.name: addInformation
methods.description: Creates a new information entry along with its descriptions, store associations, SEO URLs, and layout configurations.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: An associative array containing the information data, descriptions, SEO URLs, store IDs, and layout IDs.

methods.name: editInformation
methods.description: Updates an existing information entry and its related data such as descriptions, store associations, SEO URLs, and layout configurations.

parameters.name: information_id
parameters.description: The ID of the information entry to update.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: An associative array with updated data, descriptions, SEO URLs, store IDs, and layout IDs.

methods.name: deleteInformation
methods.description: Deletes an information entry along with its descriptions, store associations, SEO URLs, and layouts.

parameters.name: information_id
parameters.description: The ID of the information entry to delete.

methods.name: getInformation
methods.description: Retrieves detailed data of a specific information entry by its ID.

parameters.name: information_id
parameters.description: The ID of the information to fetch.

methods.name: getInformations
methods.description: Fetches a list of information entries with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Optional array of filter, sort, and pagination parameters.

methods.name: getTotalInformations
methods.description: Returns the total count of information entries in the database.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for an information entry in a specific language.

parameters.name: information_id
parameters.description: The ID of the information entry.

parameters.name: language_id
parameters.description: The language ID for the description.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: An array containing title, description, meta_title, meta_description, and meta_keyword.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a specific information entry.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a given information entry segmented by language.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a specified language across all information entries.

methods.name: addStore
methods.description: Associates an information entry with a store.

methods.name: deleteStores
methods.description: Removes all store associations for a specified information entry.

methods.name: deleteStoresByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes store associations by store ID, affecting all related information entries.

methods.name: getStores
methods.description: Retrieves a list of store IDs associated with a specific information entry.
